---
title: "vectorized_or_not"
format: html
---

```{r}
# Setup data
set.seed(123)
data_vector <- rnorm(100000) # 100,000 random numbers
results_loop <- character(length(data_vector))
```

```{r}
# Timing the loop approach
system.time({
  for (i in 1:length(data_vector)) {
    if (data_vector[i] > 0) {
      results_loop[i] <- "Positive"
    } else {
      results_loop[i] <- "Negative"
    }
  }
})
```


```{r}
# Timing the vectorized approach
system.time({
  results_vector <- ifelse(data_vector > 0, "Positive", "Negative")
})
```



```{r}
# Timing the Tidyverse vectorized approach
system.time({
  results_vector <- dplyr::if_else(data_vector > 0, "Positive", "Negative")
})
```
